Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 1. Overview

PeopleApps School Feeding Mobile Platform is a mobile application built to support school meal

program operations for organizations that coordinate schools, food suppliers, and program

administrators across many locations.

The application gives program staff a single, connected mobile system to manage school and

menu information, coordinate orders and deliveries, capture invoice evidence, track payments,

and stay informed through notifications - all from one mobile app.

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 2. Business Context

Organizations that run school feeding programs typically need to:

● Coordinate schools, menus, and participating institutions

● Plan and place food orders with suppliers on a regular basis

● Track deliveries and confirm what has been received

● Capture invoices and monitor related payments

● Keep staff and stakeholders informed as activities progress

Handling this manually across many schools and suppliers is time-consuming and error-prone.

PeopleApps School Feeding Mobile Platform centralizes the entire workflow - from school and

menu management through ordering, invoicing, and reporting - into a single, purpose-built

mobile application.

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.1 Login & Navigation

Users authenticate through a secure sign-in screen. Once signed in, they land on a central

dashboard that serves as the primary navigation hub for the application, giving users quick

access to schools, orders, invoices, finance, and notifications from one place.

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.2 School & Menu Management

● Maintain school records, including institutional details and participating status

● View and manage menu information tied to each school

● Track relevant notes and contacts associated with each school

● Quickly locate schools relevant to the user's role

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.3 Order & Supply Planning

● Plan upcoming order and menu needs ahead of time, by month or by year

● Create, review, and assign food orders and supply requests

● Track order status from creation through delivery and receipt

● Supports both individual and bulk order handling across schools

● Create and manage invoice records tied to deliveries

● Preview and confirm invoice details before submission

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.5 Finance & Payment Tracking

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.6 Notifications & Communication

The application keeps users informed through timely notifications tied to relevant activity, helping

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.7 Public Information Access

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 6. Reporting & Analytics

The application provides visibility into day-to-day program activity, including:

● Order and delivery status across schools

● Invoice and payment tracking tied to program activity

● Notification history for relevant updates

● School and menu information at a glance

Supplementing this, dedicated views cover order history, invoice records, and financial balances

- accessible directly within the application.
